topics.title: Address Position (P1)
topics.subtitle: What to check at setup
topics.defaultPrompt: Walk me through what to look for at the address position. Posture, ball position, weight distribution, alignment — what should I be checking before every swing?
topics.promptTemplate: Walk me through what to look for at address (P1) — posture, spine angle, weight distribution, ball position, alignment, grip, and stance width. {{skill_level_context}} {{view_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Beginner
options.promptFragment: Keep it simple — give me a checklist I can run before each shot.

options.label: Intermediate
options.promptFragment: I have a setup but want to refine it — help me catch what's off.

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: Include shaft lean, hand position relative to ball, sternum-to-ball relationship, and how setup variations correlate to ball flight differences.

options.label: Both Views

options.promptFragment: Give me drills and self-tests to verify my setup.

topics.title: Halfway Back (P2)
topics.subtitle: Shaft parallel to the ground in the takeaway
topics.defaultPrompt: What should I look for at P2, when the shaft is parallel to the ground in the backswing? Where should the clubface be, where should the hands be, and what does a great P2 look like?
topics.promptTemplate: Walk me through what to look for at P2 (shaft parallel to the ground in the backswing) — clubface angle, club position relative to hands, hand position, and body rotation. {{skill_level_context}} {{view_context}} {{detail_level_context}}

options.label: Intermediate

options.label: Advanced
options.promptFragment: Include face-to-toe-up, club shaft on or under hands plane, and what range of acceptable P2 looks like for different swing models.

topics.title: Transition (P5) — The Magic Move
topics.subtitle: Where the swing is won or lost
topics.defaultPrompt: Walk me through the transition from backswing to downswing — what's often called the 'magic move'. What's happening at P5 (lead arm parallel down) and what should I be looking for?
topics.promptTemplate: Walk me through transition (P5, lead arm parallel down) — pelvis lead, shaft shallowing, hand path, weight shift, and what separates great transitions from amateur ones. {{skill_level_context}} {{view_context}} {{detail_level_context}}
